Application Data.NAME: Sunnyvale Inn
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Sunnyvale Inn is a boutique hotel offering comfortable accommodations and personalized service to both leisure and business travelers. With a focus on providing a welcoming atmosphere, we have a range of amenities including complimentary breakfast, free Wi-Fi, and an outdoor pool. Our operations include room rentals, event hosting for small gatherings, and a small café serving light snacks and beverages. We prioritize the safety and privacy of our guests, adhering to strict protocols for handling sensitive client data and ensuring a secure environment for all.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2021, a fire caused by an electrical failure in the kitchen resulted in $5,000 in damages. The incident has been fully resolved and the amount was covered by insurance. On 11/10/2022, a plumbing leak caused water damage in one of the guest rooms, leading to $10,000 in repair costs. This claim is still in process with the insurer.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the property, along with a dedicated night watchperson to enhance safety and deter unauthorized access.
